kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ننحلب (form VII)
# نَنْحَلِبُ (nanḥalibu) /nan.ħa.li.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْحَلَبَ (inḥalaba)
# نَنْحَلِبَ (nanḥaliba) /nan.ħa.li.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْحَلَبَ (inḥalaba)
# نَنْحَلِبْ (nanḥalib) /nan.ħa.lib/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْحَلَبَ (inḥalaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
